description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

Build and operate the backend for an AI assistant that communicates through text, email, and phone. As a hands-on founding engineer, you will own systems where reliable, timely message delivery is essential and help shape the team's engineering standards.


WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Design and operate messaging pipelines for inbound and outbound communications, with reliable ordering, retries, and delivery tracking.

 - Build the background agent runtime, including concurrency controls, timeouts, cancellation, and recovery from model or tool failures.

 - Develop scheduling systems for future actions that must run reliably and in the correct time zone.

 - Plan capacity, load-test services, optimize databases, and make architectural improvements to support growth.

 - Own security and privacy practices, including credential encryption, Postgres schemas and migrations, and data deletion workflows.

 - Build observability and cost tracking that traces messages through downstream model and tool calls.

 - Set backend engineering standards and help recruit and mentor a growing engineering team while remaining hands-on.


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - At least 4 years of software engineering experience, including substantial production on-call responsibility.

 - Deep distributed systems experience with queues, workers, retries, idempotency, and production failure modes.

 - Experience scaling production systems through rapid growth and making sound tradeoffs about what to address immediately.

 - Production experience with Postgres, including schema design, migrations, and performance tuning, as well as cloud infrastructure and infrastructure as code.

 - Experience shipping production systems in TypeScript or Python.

 - Background in messaging, telephony, or event-driven systems where dropped or duplicated events have real costs.

 - Experience with observability, distributed tracing, capacity planning, and measuring latency and cost.

 - Hands-on technical leadership and familiarity with AI-assisted development workflows, including verifying and owning generated code.


COMPENSATION & BENEFITS

Base salary: $200,000 to $300,000 annually. Visa sponsorship is not available.


LOCATION

Full-time, on-site in San Francisco, California.
